title: WP-SEC-B: security-composition matrix + the security gate command (badf-security-design -> IMPLEMENTED)
objective: Advance badf-security-design DESIGNED -> IMPLEMENTED by giving its security-composition matrix a schema and structural validation in the one canonical gate. Add schemas/security-composition.schema.json (threat rows with security_id, source provenance, disposition, optional control/sec-req/verification refs, and a residual_risk enum that omits a bare ACCEPTED so SEC-I12 is structural) and a `security` subcommand -> validate_security_composition with structural controls earned failing-first: no-empty-matrix; SEC-C01 unique security_id; SEC-C02 each threat binds >=1 provenance source (SEC-I02); SEC-C03 a controlled threat carries >=1 control (SEC-I03). business_value: IMPLEMENTED makes the security reasoning machine-addressable: the threat->provenance->disposition->control chain becomes a checkable artifact instead of prose, so later WPs (seam controls, shadow, admission) build on a validated matrix. Baking SEC-I12 into the schema (no ACCEPTED value) means the skill structurally cannot self-accept residual risk -- an invariant enforced by construction, not by review.
